title: F de C de Rigueur Reader 2012-1

description.main: The first 2012 issue of the F de C de Rigueur Reader, a small paperback edited by Alin Huma with contributions from Erik Bernhardsson, Robert Cook and Antonin Gaultier. It runs to 179 pages and carries no ISBN.
description.extended:
The first 2012 issue of the F de C de Rigueur Reader, a small-format paperback edited by Alin Huma with contributions from Erik Bernhardsson, Robert Cook and Antonin Gaultier.

The book runs to 179 pages and measures 14.5 by 10 cm. Its cover sets a black-and-white portrait of a woman in a patterned jacket above the line "Things will develop in the opposite direction when they reach their limit." The distributor describes the contents in a run of fragments: memory as future, fabric as spore, pixels as nostalgia, inland seas as exposures, and painted whiteness as the thing already said said again with meaning.

The publisher is credited as FdeC(deR), and the numbering, 2012-1, marks it as one issue of a continuing reader.

notes: No ISBN. Published as FdeC(deR). The publisher link goes to the Motto Distribution listing. Identified from a spine photograph; edition not checked against the copy.
